accuracy.protocol: each repeat evaluated separately, then averaged - the same protocol the registry's oof_pr_auc uses; scores are out-of-fold so no row is scored by a model that saw it
accuracy.calibration: frozen Platt calibrator from the bundle applied to raw out-of-fold scores before every probability metric, matching the production path exactly

probes.selection: seeded sample of development rows (seed=42, sorted by row_index)
